                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    HCF of two numbers = 22

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    LCM = 308

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    One number = 44

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Formula used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    LCM × HCF = one number × other number

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Let the other number be x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    According to the question

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ (308 × 22) = 44 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = (308 × 22)/44

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = 154

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ The other number is 154

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    दो संख्याओं का महत्तम समापवर्तक = 22

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    लघुत्तम समापवर्तक = 308

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    एक संख्या = 44

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    लघुत्तम समापवर्तक × महत्तम समापवर्तक = एक संख्या × अन्य संख्या

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    माना अन्य संख्या x है

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    प्रश्न के अनुसार

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ (308 × 22) = 44 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = (308 × 22)/44

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = 154

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ अन्य संख्या 154 है। 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n", "te": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ఇచ్చిన దత్తాంశం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    రెండు సంఖ్యల గ.సా.భ = 22

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    క.సా.గు = 308

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ఒక సంఖ్య = 44

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    క.సా.గు × గ.సా.భ= ఒక సంఖ్య × మరొక సంఖ్య

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    సాధన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ఇతర సంఖ్య x గా అనుకుందాం

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ప్రశ్న ప్రకారం

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ (308 × 22) = 44 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = (308 × 22)/44

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = 154

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴  సంఖ్య 154

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n", "mr": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    दिलेले आहे:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    दोन संख्यांचा मसावि = 22

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    लसावि = 308

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    एक संख्या = 44

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    वापरलेले सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    लसावि × मसावि = एक संख्या × दुसरी संख्या

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    दुसरी संख्या x मानू

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    प्रश्नानुसार

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ (308 × 22) = 44 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = (308 × 22)/44

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = 154

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ दुसरी संख्या 154 आहे

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n", "bn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    দুটি সংখ্যার গ.সা.গু = 22

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ল.সা.গু = 308

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    একটি সংখ্যা = 44

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    অনুসৃত সূত্র:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ল.সা.গু × গ.সা.গু = একটি সংখ্যা × অন্য সংখ্যাটি 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ধরি অন্য সংখ্যাটি হল x 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    প্রশ্ন অনুযায়ী

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ (308 × 22) = 44 × x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = (308 × 22)/44

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = 154

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ অন্য সংখ্যাটি হল 154

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n", "ml": "", "gu": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    આપેલ છે:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    બે સંખ્યાઓનો  ગુસાઅ = 22

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    લસાઅ = 308

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    એક સંખ્યા = 44

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ઉપયોગમાં લેવાયેલ સૂત્ર:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     LCM  x  ગુસાઅ= એક સંખ્યા x બીજી સંખ્યા

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ગણતરી:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ધારો કે બીજી સંખ્યા x છે

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    પ્રશ્ન મુજબ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ (308 x 22) = 44 x x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = (308 x 22)/44

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ x = 154

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ બીજી સંખ્યા 154 છે

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ 154 ಆಗಿದೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The correct answer is Dam water.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Dam water has potential energy.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • In the absence of the dams, the water would flow downstream. However, the dam stops the flow of the water and accumulates the water in it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • This increases the height of the water with respect to the ground.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Since the water has a height above the ground, it will have stored potential energy.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Potential energy is the stored energy in any object or system by virtue of its position or arrangement of parts.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • However, it isn't affected by the environment outside of the object or system, such as air or height.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Mechanical energy, sum of the kinetic energy, or energy of motion, and the potential energy, or energy stored in a system by reason of the position of its parts.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Neglecting friction at the pivot and air resistance, the sum of the kinetic and potential energy.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Kinetic energy is a form of energy that an object or a particle has by reason of its motion. \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Kinetic energy is a property of a moving object or particle and depends not only on its motion but also on its mass.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    सही उत्‍तर बांध का पानी है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • बांध के पानी में स्थितिज ऊर्जा होती है।\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • बांधों के अभाव में, पानी नीचे की ओर बहेगा। हालांकि, बांध पानी के प्रवाह को रोक देता है और उसमें पानी जमा कर देता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • इससे जमीन के सापेक्ष पानी की ऊंचाई बढ़ जाती है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • चूंकि पानी की ऊंचाई जमीन से ऊपर है, इसलिए इसमें संभावित ऊर्जा संग्रहित होगी।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
